description: Remembers how the user likes to work, so every future session starts with it (resume_session). Call when the user states a lasting preference or corrects you in a way that should stick: code style, conventions, workflow (e.g. "always show the plan before writing"), how they want answers. One sentence, phrased as guidance. scope user (default) follows them to every project; project applies here only. Never store secrets or personal data. replaceId rewrites one.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

text.description: The preference, as guidance, e.g. "Prefers small PRs with one slice each"

name: remember_preference
title: Remember a user preference
